findings.evidence_quote: Shares of our Class A Common Stock trade on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the trading symbol “MQ”.
findings.reason: Marqeta, Inc.'s current investor FAQ identifies its common shares as trading on Nasdaq under ticker MQ. The current-stage discovery disclosed a 2025 acquisition by Marqeta of TransactPay, not an acquisition of Marqeta, and no completed delisting, take-private, or controlling acquisition of Marqeta.
